findings.description: Direct inspection of current V203 renders: the added under-shorts cover both upper thighs in sit and crouch, but the visible shorts terminate high while pale fabric hangs behind bent legs; in back view gray legs interrupt both shorts hems. The new coverage geometry therefore does not yet read or behave as a consistently fitted garment through hip flexion.

Front and three-quarter show irregular triangular faceting rather than controlled broad pleat channels. Sit and crouch produce doubled lilac-edged hem with sharp points between and beside knees; prone still tents and bunches the garment over and beneath the torso.
Front view retains small gray body patches at both armpits; arms-up still shows a sleeve-root/armhole coverage interruption. Shoulder and sleeve surface also retain conspicuous faceting.

nextAction: Keep V203 rejected. Correct the shorts/panel layer assignment and thigh weighting so the hems follow both legs through hip flexion without gray-body intersections; reshape front pleats and stabilize the continuous hem in sit and crouch; reduce prone tenting with a garment-specific support/collision response; close sleeve-root coverage gaps. Rebuild and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Prototype appearance remains rejected and fit, rig, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat execution, package, and release evidence are not complete.
